## What's Changed
* fix: support project directories with non-ASCII names by @theshasha in https://github.com/openchamber/opencode-claude/pull/65
* fix: write session titles in the request's language by @theshasha in https://github.com/openchamber/opencode-claude/pull/64
* fix: accept string-encoded tool arguments from Claude by @bernhardberger in https://github.com/openchamber/opencode-claude/pull/61

## New Contributors
* @theshasha made their first contribution in https://github.com/openchamber/opencode-claude/pull/65
* @bernhardberger made their first contribution in https://github.com/openchamber/opencode-claude/pull/61

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/openchamber/opencode-claude/compare/v1.4.2...v1.5.0

## What's Changed
* fix: stop a turn parked on a history another provider compacted by @mradwankhalil in https://github.com/openchamber/opencode-claude/pull/57

## New Contributors
* @mradwankhalil made their first contribution in https://github.com/openchamber/opencode-claude/pull/57

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/openchamber/opencode-claude/compare/v1.4.1...v1.4.2

## What's Changed
* fix: show Opus 5.5's pre-tool narration as text, not thinking by @JosueGalRe in https://github.com/openchamber/opencode-claude/pull/55
* fix(models): treat Claude Haiku 5.5 as a native 1M model by @aaa1124 in https://github.com/openchamber/opencode-claude/pull/51

## New Contributors
* @JosueGalRe made their first contribution in https://github.com/openchamber/opencode-claude/pull/55
* @aaa1124 made their first contribution in https://github.com/openchamber/opencode-claude/pull/51

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/openchamber/opencode-claude/compare/v1.4.0...v1.4.1

## What's Changed
* feat: list Sonnet 5.5 in the fallback catalog by @fgbm in https://github.com/openchamber/opencode-claude/pull/45
* fix: name the tool in transferred tool results by @fgbm in https://github.com/openchamber/opencode-claude/pull/46
* fix: drop the 900k input limit on 1M models by @android6 in https://github.com/openchamber/opencode-claude/pull/48
* fix: hand the Agent SDK a native claude.exe on Windows (#40) by @daveotero in https://github.com/openchamber/opencode-claude/pull/47

## New Contributors
* @daveotero made their first contribution in https://github.com/openchamber/opencode-claude/pull/47

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/openchamber/opencode-claude/compare/v1.3.9...v1.4.0

## What's Changed
* fix: stop asking for an OpenCode restart after claude auth login by @yulia-ivashko in https://github.com/openchamber/opencode-claude/pull/49

## New Contributors
* @yulia-ivashko made their first contribution in https://github.com/openchamber/opencode-claude/pull/49

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/openchamber/opencode-claude/compare/v1.3.8...v1.3.9

issues.title: API Error: 400 Third-party apps now draw from extra usage, not plan limits
Concurrent continuation pumps overlap reads on the shared Claude stream iterator; resumed buffered request leaks its SDK handle on abort
Windows: EINVAL spawning npm claude.cmd shim (cmd.exe special characters in SDK --settings JSON)
Compaction continuations over-count usage and miss update-summary metadata
v2: register the provider before setup waits on the proxy and CLI probe (Model unavailable during plugin re-activation)
